title: Zap-Stark
tagline: Zap-Stark: A Telegram mini-app for seamless token swaps on Starknet. Instant self-custodial wallets, best prices via Avnu, and gas-free trades for early users. Experience Starknet's smooth UX and low fees without leaving Telegram!

description:
Zap-Stark is an innovative Telegram mini-app that brings the power of Starknet's Layer 2 scaling solution directly to users' favourite messaging platform. Our project aims to simplify the crypto trading experience by eliminating barriers to entry and providing a seamless, user-friendly interface.
Key features include:

Integrated wallet creation: Users can instantly set up a self-custodial wallet powered by Dynamic, ensuring they maintain control of their assets.
Best swap prices: We've integrated Avnu to provide users with the most competitive rates for token swaps.
Gas-free experience: To showcase Starknet's efficiency, we're covering gas fees for a limited number of early adopters, cause it's so damn cheap :) 
Seamless UX: Users can trade directly within Telegram, eliminating the need to switch between multiple apps.
Starknet benefits: By leveraging Starknet's Layer 2 technology, users enjoy fast transactions and low fees.

Zap-Stark democratizes access to decentralized finance by bringing it to a platform used by millions daily. It combines the security and efficiency of Starknet with the convenience and familiarity of Telegram, creating a powerful tool for both crypto enthusiasts and newcomers alike.
how_its_made: Zap-Stark is built as a Telegram mini-app, leveraging Starknet's Layer 2 technology for fast, low-cost transactions. We integrated Dynamic's SDK for seamless wallet creation and Avnu for optimal swap rates. Our backend manages interactions with Starknet and user sessions, while the frontend provides an intuitive interface within Telegram
